verses.geez: ፈራሄ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይገብር፡ ከመዝ፡ ወዘየዐቅብ፡ ሕጎ፡ ይረክባ።
verses.translation: He that feareth the Lord will do good; and he that hath the knowledge of the law shall obtain her;

translations.lxx: He that feareth the Lord will do good; and he that hath the knowledge of the law shall obtain her;
translations.ron: Cel care se teme de Domnul va face cele bune, şi cel care ţine legea o va cuprinde pe ea.
translations.grk: Ὁ φοβούμενος Κύριον ποιήσει αὐτὸ, καὶ ὁ ἐγκρατὴς τοῦ νόμου καταλήψεται αὐτήν·

verses.geez: ወትጸንሖ፡ ከመ፡ እሙ፡ ወተሐቅፎ፡ ከመ፡ ብእሲት፡ ድንግል።
verses.translation: and as a mother shall she meet him, and receive him as a wife married of a virgin.

translations.lxx: and as a mother shall she meet him, and receive him as a wife married of a virgin.
translations.ron: Şi-l va întâmpina ca o mamă şi ca femeia tinereţilor îl va primi.
translations.grk: καὶ ὑπαντήσεται αὐτῷ ὡς μήτηρ, καὶ ὡς γυνὴ παρθενίας προσδέξεται αὐτόν·

verses.geez: ወትሴስዮ፡ እክለ፡ ጥበብ፡ ወታሰትዮ፡ ማየ፡ አእምሮ።
verses.translation: With the bread of understanding shall she feed him, and give him the water of wisdom to drink.

translations.lxx: With the bread of understanding shall she feed him, and give him the water of wisdom to drink.
translations.ron: Îl va hrăni cu pâinea înţelegerii, şi cu apa înţelepciunii îl va adăpa.
translations.grk: ψωμιεῖ αὐτὸν ἄρτον συνέσεως, καὶ ὕδωρ σοφίας ποτίσει αὐτόν.

verses.geez: ወይትመረጐዝ፡ ባቲ፡ ወኢይተነትን፡ ወይትአመን፡ ባቲ፡ ወኢይትኀፈር።
verses.translation: He shall be stayed upon her, and shall not be moved; and shall rely upon her, and shall not be confounded.

translations.lxx: He shall be stayed upon her, and shall not be moved; and shall rely upon her, and shall not be confounded.
translations.ron: Rezema-se-va întru ea şi nu se va clătina; se va ţine de ea şi nu se va ruşina.
translations.grk: Στηριχθήσεται ἐπʼ αὐτὴν καὶ οὐ μὴ κλιθῇ, καὶ ἐπʼ αὐτῆς ἐφέξει καὶ οὐ μὴ καταισχυνθῇ.

verses.geez: ወታዐቢዮ፡ እምነ፡ ቢጹ፡ ወበማእከለ፡ ብዙኃን፡ ይከሥት፡ አፉሁ።
verses.translation: She shall exalt him above his neighbours, and in the midst of the congregation shall she open his mouth.

translations.lxx: She shall exalt him above his neighbours, and in the midst of the congregation shall she open his mouth.
translations.ron: Şi îl va înălţa pe el mai mult decât pe cei de aproape ai lui şi în mijlocul adunării va deschide gura lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὑψώσει αὐτὸν παρὰ τοὺς πλησίον αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐν μέσῳ ἐκκλησίας ἀνοίξει στόμα αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወትሁቦ፡ አክሊለ፡ (ጥበብ፡ወ)ትፍሥሕት፡ ወሐሤት፡ ወይወርስ፡ ስመ፡ ዘለዓለም።
verses.translation: He shall find joy and a crown of gladness, and she shall cause him to inherit an everlasting name.

translations.lxx: He shall find joy and a crown of gladness, and she shall cause him to inherit an everlasting name.
translations.ron: Desfătare şi cunună de bucurie şi nume veşnic va moşteni.
translations.grk: Εὐφροσύνην καὶ στέφανον ἀγαλλιάματος καὶ ὄνομα αἰώνιον κατακληρονομήσει.

verses.geez: ወአብዳንሰ፡ ኢይረክብዋ፡ ወኃጥኣንሰ፡ ኢይሬእይዋ።
verses.translation: But foolish men shall not attain unto her, and sinners shall not see her.

translations.lxx: But foolish men shall not attain unto her, and sinners shall not see her.
translations.ron: Oamenii cei nebuni nu vor cuprinde înţelepciunea şi bărbaţii cei păcătoşi nu o vor vedea;
translations.grk: Οὐ μὴ καταλήψονται αὐτὴν ἄνθρωποι ἀσύνετοι, καὶ ἄνδρες ἁμαρτωλοὶ οὐ μὴ ἴδωσιν αὐτήν.

verses.geez: ርሕቅት፡ እምነ፡ ዕቡያን፡ ወሐሳውያንኒ፡ ኢይዜከርዋ።
verses.translation: For she is far from pride, and men that are liars cannot remember her.

translations.lxx: For she is far from pride, and men that are liars cannot remember her.
translations.ron: Departe este de trufie şi oamenii cei mincinoşi nu-şi vor aduce aminte de ea.
translations.grk: Μακράν ἐστιν ὑπερηφανίας, καὶ ἄνδρες ψεῦσται οὐ μὴ μνησθήσονται αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ኢኮነ፡ አዳመ፡ ቃለ፡ አፉሁ፡ ለኃጥእ፡ እስመ፡ ኢኮነ፡ በፍርሃተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘይነብብ።
verses.translation: Praise is not seemly in the mouth of a sinner, for it was not sent him of the Lord.

translations.lxx: Praise is not seemly in the mouth of a sinner, for it was not sent him of the Lord.
translations.ron: Nu este frumoasă lauda în gura păcătosului, că nu este de la Domnul trimisă lui.
translations.grk: Οὐχ ὡραῖος αἶνος ἐν στόματι ἁμαρτωλοῦ, ὅτι οὐ παρὰ Κυρίου ἀπεστάλη.

verses.geez: በጥበብ፡ ይነግርዋ፡ ለአምሳል፡ ወእግዚአብሔር፡ ይረድኦ፡ ለዘ፡ ይትሜሀር።
verses.translation: For praise shall be uttered in wisdom, and the Lord will prosper it.

translations.lxx: For praise shall be uttered in wisdom, and the Lord will prosper it.
translations.ron: Că întru înţelepciune se va grăi lauda şi Domnul o va îndrepta pe ea.
translations.grk: Ἐν γὰρ σοφίᾳ ῥηθήσεται αἶνος, καὶ ὁ Κύριος εὐοδώσει αὐτόν.

verses.geez: ኢትበል፡ በእንተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ተሐረምኩ፡ ወዘውእቱ፡ ጸልአ፡ ኢትግበር።
verses.translation: Say not thou, It is through the Lord that I fell away: for thou oughtest not to do the things that he hateth.

translations.lxx: Say not thou, It is through the Lord that I fell away: for thou oughtest not to do the things that he hateth.
translations.ron: Să nu zici: Domnul m-a depărtat, că cele ce El le-a urât nu le va face.
translations.grk: Μὴ εἴπῃς, ὅτι διὰ Κύριον ἀπέστην· ἃ γὰρ ἐμίσησεν, οὐ ποιήσεις.

verses.geez: ወኢትበል፡ ውእቱ፡ አስሐተኒ፡ ውእቱሰ፡ ኢይፈቅድ፡ ብእሴ፡ ኃጥእ።
verses.translation: Say not thou, He hath caused me to err: for he hath no need of the sinful man.

translations.lxx: Say not thou, He hath caused me to err: for he hath no need of the sinful man.
translations.ron: Să nu zici: El m-a înşelat; n-are El lipsă de omul păcătos.
translations.grk: Μὴ εἴπῃς, ὅτι αὐτός με ἐπλάνησεν· οὐ γὰρ χρείαν ἔχει ἀνδρὸς ἁμαρτωλοῦ.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ኵሎ፡ ርኩስ፡ ጸልአ፡ እግዚአብሔር፤….።
verses.translation: The Lord hateth all abomination; and they that fear God love it not.

translations.lxx: The Lord hateth all abomination; and they that fear God love it not.
translations.ron: Toată urâciunea o urăşte Domnul, şi nu este iubită celor care se tem de Dânsul.
translations.grk: Πᾶν βδέλυγμα ἐμίσησε Κύριος, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἀγαπητὸν τοῖς φοβουμένοις αὐτόν.

verses.geez: ውእቱ፡ ገብሮ፡ ለእጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ቀዳሚሁ፡ ወኀደጎ፡ በግዕዙ፡ በዘፈቀደ።
verses.translation: He himself made man from the beginning, and left him in the hand of his counsel;

translations.lxx: He himself made man from the beginning, and left him in the hand of his counsel;
translations.ron: El din început a făcut pe om şi l-a lăsat în mâna sfatului său.
translations.grk: Αὐτὸς ἐξ ἀρχῆς ἐποίησεν ἄνθρωπον, καὶ ἀφῆκεν αὐτὸν ἐν χειρὶ διαβουλίου αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወለእመሰ፡ ትፈቅድ፡ ትዕቀብ፡ ትእዛዞ፡ ወትግበር፡ ሃይማኖተ፡ ፈቃዱ።
verses.translation: if thou wilt, to keep the commandments, and to perform acceptable faithfulness.

translations.lxx: if thou wilt, to keep the commandments, and to perform acceptable faithfulness.
translations.ron: De vei vrea, vei ţine poruncile şi credinţa şi vei face cele bine-plăcute.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν θέλῃς, συντηρήσεις ἐντολὰς, καὶ πίστιν ποιῆσαι εὐδοκίας.

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ አንበረ፡ ለከ፡ እሳተ፡ ወማየ፡ ከመ፡ ትደይ፡ እዴከ፡ ኀበ፡ ኀረይከ።
verses.translation: He hath set fire and water before thee: stretch forth thy hand unto whether thou wilt.

translations.lxx: He hath set fire and water before thee: stretch forth thy hand unto whether thou wilt.
translations.ron: Pus-a înaintea ta foc şi apă, şi ori la care vei vrea, vei întinde mâna ta.
translations.grk: Παρέθηκέ σοι πῦρ καὶ ὕδωρ, οὗ ἐὰν θέλῃς ἐκτενεῖς τὴν χεῖρά σου.

verses.geez: ሕይወትኒ፡ ወሞትኒ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ለእጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ወዘኀረየ፡ እምውስቴቱ፡ ይሁብዎ።
verses.translation: Before man is life and death; and whether he liketh shall be given him.

translations.lxx: Before man is life and death; and whether he liketh shall be given him.
translations.ron: Înaintea oamenilor este viaţa şi moartea şi oricare le va plăcea li se va da,
translations.grk: Ἔναντι ἀνθρώπων ἡ ζωὴ καὶ ὁ θάνατος, καὶ ὃ ἐὰν εὐδοκήσῃ δοθήσεται αὐτῷ.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ጥበበሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ጽኑዕ፡ ኀይሉ፡ ወያአምር፡ ኵሎ፡ ወይሬኢ።
verses.translation: For the wisdom of the Lord is great, and he is mighty in power, and beholdeth all things:

translations.lxx: For the wisdom of the Lord is great, and he is mighty in power, and beholdeth all things:
translations.ron: Că multă este înţelepciunea Domnului; tare este El întru putere şi vede toate.
translations.grk: Ὅτι πολλὴ σοφία τοῦ Κυρίου, ἰσχυρὸς ἐν δυναστείᾳ καὶ βλέπων τὰ πάντα.

verses.geez: ወአዕይንቲሁኒ፡ ኀበ፡ እለ፡ ይፈርህዎ፡ ውእቱ፡ ያአምር፡ ኵሎ፡ ግብሮ፡ ለእጓለ፡ እመሕያው።
verses.translation: and his eyes are upon them that fear him, and he knoweth every work of man.

translations.lxx: and his eyes are upon them that fear him, and he knoweth every work of man.
translations.ron: Şi ochii Lui sunt peste cei care se tem de El, şi El va cunoaşte tot lucrul omului.
translations.grk: Καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τοὺς φοβουμένους αὐτὸν, καὶ αὐτὸς ἐπιγνώσεται πᾶν ἔργον ἀνθρώπου.

verses.geez: ወውእቱሰ፡ አልቦ፡ ለዘ፡ አዘዘ፡ ይግበሩ፡ ኀጢአተ፡ ወኢያብሐ፡ ወኢለመኑሂ፡ ከመ፡ ያአብሱ።
verses.translation: He hath commanded no man to do wickedly, neither hath he given any man licence to sin.

translations.lxx: He hath commanded no man to do wickedly, neither hath he given any man licence to sin.
translations.ron: Şi nimănui n-a poruncit să lucreze nelegiuit şi nimănui n-a dat libertate să păcătuiască.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐκ ἐνετείλατο οὐδενὶ ἀσεβεῖν, καὶ οὐκ ἔδωκεν ἄνεσιν οὐδενὶ ἁμαρτάνειν.
